name: deskfleet_remote_machines
description: List other online machines in this Session's Team that permit remote Agent access. Returns their IDs and current read/operate/session/workspace permissions.

name: deskfleet_remote_machine
description: Read a remote machine's Workspaces, directories and public Agent provider information. Use deskfleet_remote_provider_configuration to inspect a provider's available models, reasoning efforts, modes, and configuration options. Requires the target's read, session or workspace permission.

name: deskfleet_remote_provider_configuration
description: Inspect an Agent provider's available models, reasoning efforts, modes, and configuration options on another machine before creating or messaging a Session. Optionally pass workspaceId or partial configuration (such as model) to inspect model-dependent options. Requires the target's read or session permission.

configValues.description: Additional provider-specific configuration options keyed by configOption id.

name: deskfleet_remote_sessions
description: List Agent Sessions on another machine, optionally filtered by Workspace. Requires the target's read permission.

name: deskfleet_remote_session
description: Read a remote Agent Session's state and conversation snapshot. Requires the target's read permission. Does not send messages or resume the Agent.

name: deskfleet_remote_session_history
description: Read recorded conversation/tool events on another machine. Start at afterSeq 0 and continue with the last event's seq. Requires read permission.

name: deskfleet_remote_session_create
description: Create an Agent Session on another machine for task orchestration (not lightweight in-task subagent work) and optionally submit its first prompt. Select an Agent provider from deskfleet_remote_machine and optional model/reasoningEffort/mode/configValues from deskfleet_remote_provider_configuration. Omit workspaceId to start a machine-scoped Session in the remote home directory. Requires the target's session permission.

yolo.description: Auto-approve permission requests in the created Session. Defaults to true when the parent Session is YOLO (pass false to opt down); rejected when the parent Session is not YOLO.

configValues.description: Additional provider-specific configuration options keyed by configOption id.

name: deskfleet_remote_session_send
description: Submit a prompt to an Agent Session on another machine. Optionally switch the Agent provider or update configuration (model, reasoningEffort, mode, configValues) before submitting; changing provider or configuration requires backlog delivery and an idle Session. Backlog messages resume a stopped or interrupted Session; steer messages require an active turn. Requires the target's session permission.

configValues.description: Additional provider-specific configuration options keyed by configOption id.

name: deskfleet_remote_workspace_create
description: Create a Workspace on another machine from one or more existing remote absolute directory paths; the first path is the default directory. Requires the target's workspace permission.

directories.description: Ordered absolute directory paths; the first directory is the Workspace default.

name: deskfleet_remote_mcp_servers
description: List enabled, configured MCP servers on another machine. Returns server IDs and names without connection credentials. Requires read or operate permission.

name: deskfleet_remote_mcp_tools
description: Discover a configured remote MCP server's tools and argument schemas. Pass nextCursor as cursor for another page. Requires read or operate permission.

name: deskfleet_remote_mcp_call
description: Call a tool from a configured MCP server on another machine. Use its discovered name and argument schema. Always requires the target's operate permission, including tools marked read-only. A failed or timed-out call may already have taken effect; do not blindly retry. This does not expose DeskFleet Agent messaging or scheduled-task tools.
